command: cd ~/Projects/prc-challenge && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 nice -n 19 /usr/bin/time -l python3.11 -B -u scripts/lgbm_fold.py --ytarget --all-rows --queue --unmatched-weight 1,10 --baseline A2 --pa-trees es 2>&1 | tee reports/lgbm_fold_queue_allrows.console.log
estimate: ~3.1 h (range 2.5-4 h): the allrows estimate x1.15 for 81 columns; peak RSS ~4.9 GB. The matched pipeline is READ from the queue record; prerequisites as for allrows plus data/cache_queue/. Writes reports/lgbm_fold_queue_allrows.{json,log} and data/cache_stand/fold_preds_queue_allrows.parquet.

config.columns: every arm column is a TAXI TIME (the unmatched rows have no proxy); U_w{W}_seed{s} the per-seed y predictions before the 1 s floor; baseline_* the matched record in the delta form, NaN on unmatched rows

pipeline.definition: matched: A2 + QUEUE_FEATS (queue predictions); unmatched: the stratum record's S0

U_w1.definition: unified y-target regressor, unmatched weight 1, best_iter 1,354 -> n_ref 1,692, mean over seeds [0, 1, 2], max(., 1)

U_w10.definition: unified y-target regressor, unmatched weight 10, best_iter 1,047 -> n_ref 1,309, mean over seeds [0, 1, 2], max(., 1)

matched.definition: rows with an NM off-block (the matched record's fold)

total_2026.definition: sqrt(w_m x MSE_matched + w_u x MSE_unmatched) at the 2026 scored-file shares 339,551 / 5,290 of 344,841, stratified paired row bootstrap
